statement:
∀ (N k : ℕ), Even N → 1 ≤ k →
  let q : ℕ := 2^k
  let m : ℕ := 2^(k+1)
  ∀ f : ZMod m → ℝ,
    let D := fun r : ℕ => f (r : ZMod m) - f ((r+q : ℕ) : ZMod m)
    let s := (Finset.univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ m)).filter (fun χ => χ.conductor = m)
    let v := fun χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m =>
      (∑ x : (ZMod m)ˣ, (f (x : ZMod m) : ℂ) * star (χ (x : ZMod m))) /
        (Real.sqrt (m.totient : ℝ) : ℂ)
    let H := fun χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m =>
      (∑ x : (ZMod m)ˣ, star (χ (x : ZMod m)) * ψ ((N : ZMod m) - (x : ZMod m))) / (m.totient : ℂ)
    (∑ r ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => Odd r),
      (if (N+2*q-r)%(2*q) < q then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * D r * D ((N+q-r)%q)) =
      2 * (∑ χ ∈ s, ∑ ψ ∈ s, star (v χ) * H χ ψ * v ψ).re

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0012 · 用本原特征二次型精确计算奇余类的反射增量
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0012 · Compute the odd-residue increment exactly by a primitive-character quadratic form

brief.zh: 用 f 的半差作本原投影。写成单位群正交归一基中的二次型后，两子类各贡献一次，粗类带符号的和等于二次型实部的两倍。
brief.en: Project f by taking its half-difference across the two children. In the orthonormal unit basis, the two children give the same contribution. The signed coarse sum equals twice the real part of the form.
